about: The secreta of the formulary “Low Sunday” in the 1962 Roman Missal.

seg.tr: Lord, we ask You to receive the gifts of the rejoicing Church and grant the fruit of perpetual joy to the Church to which You have given a cause of such great joy. Through our Lord Jesus Christ, Your Son, who lives and reigns with You in the unity of the Holy Spirit, God,

a.g: grant the fruit of everlasting joy
